It’s the best restaurant in Madrid to us! The vibe is perfect, the gentleman who helped us, explained the whole menu to us in English! Everyone works here is just so nice. The dishes taste great and have HUGE PORTIONS!! We spent around 20€ per person but the food is enough for our dinner tonight and breakfast tomorrow! Absolutely amazing place!!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMCAiuualwE&fid=0x0:0x581949e25fe7583d"],"When":"2025-1-30"},{"Name":"Sam","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIF6ThgVurUSV8GTB0Yjf-sextIUcsBWuCYmOhCjugPac8hHA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Friendly staff, fast service. Good prices. I can imagine this place gets very busy later in the evening, so it might be difficult to find a table. I asked for the meat to be cooked medium but looks more like medium rare to me. Portion is big and definitely too much for one person unless you have a big appetite, and to be fair to the restaurant it does say the meal is for two people. But for €22 it was okay to buy for one person knowing you might not eat it all. But honestly the meat didn’t have much flavour, and it was covered in salt. Worth a try if you are a meat lover, but lower your expectations. Next time I’ll try something else from the menu","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgID9nLKUHg&fid=0x0:0x581949e25fe7583d"],"When":"2024-3-14"},{"Name":"Wendy Ng","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLgw8xqXAXcHRJIFL94ZiTmnEZtoeP1omjw1-g6e2ZYlklAVg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This is NOT a tourist trap. It is a restaurant that sells meat and they do it exceptionally. The menu was all in Spanish which was a great sign. I had a starter of tomatoes dressed with thinly sliced onions, chopped garlic and olive oil and salt...perfection. The steak Super Lingota de Limusina was done to my request of medium...tender, nicely seasoned and on a bed of home sliced, thick cut chips. The absolute best meal I've had in Madrid.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBTsBajAnAcy9rD1hOvcQVS&fid=0x0:0x581949e25fe7583d"],"When":"2025-6-16"},{"Name":"Alex G","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWgrWVQACfy5Qdydcy4cYWaGWceljTlVG6VgxbUPt5nLkMGCw2P5w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The staff at "Busca" were extremely welcoming and very friendly! I sat at the bar and started off with a draft beer and a side dish (which they give you regardless).

I then ordered a delicious skewer. The meat was done to perfection. I then ended with a vermouth on the rocks.

Highly recommend.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICH9ILTag&fid=0x0:0x581949e25fe7583d"],"When":"2024-9-1"}]

[{"Name":"Tony Russo","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXjGZ0MHMi2zJVMeMrJFcwWRZC6LZYQCgS5HOKAOitHW_hh8NA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Great food, and well paced. The service was kind, but uneven. For the price, I expected a bit more. We poured are own wine, glasses took time to clear, we asked for things they didn’t deliver, and they were missing key menu items at opening. We struggled to hear each other at times. We were overall happy with the experience, and I would recommend this place for dinner. It was the best meat we ate the entire trip.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDM17SEQlNNpl85vuUPmRB9&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-11-16"},{"Name":"aleksandar todorov","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUQnUdGGxf1py7zZGCrXpUqOWgFSSiU1GO1fw5-vbkEDM9R5Api=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We had an amazing two visits of this Restaurant! The food was so delicious - we tried a different types of meat and all of it was great! The wine, the deserts, the compliments also! And not in the last place- the service was so nice, i can’t give less than 5 Stars! Thanks","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDRZ9pt9zYlhjPm0v0s7vfD&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2026-1-4"},{"Name":"sampi16 sampi16","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKPGPPXV7zILaB_lgbQlvGy6ZdwEDK8lAp3JTgivfjlBMLcrQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"SUPER happy! Our evening at Raza was nothing short of great. I had made the reservation a long time ago as I had read good things about the place. With somewhat high expectations they blew us out of the water. I was afraid we were going to be late so I called saying that we might come a couple of minutes late and the gentleman I spoke to was super understanding, plus points already.

Starting off with the interior, you walk in to an open flame grill, the aromas are awesome and the dark mysterious vibe is super intriguing. Table settings are beautiful and tables are big and spacious and very comfortable chairs.

The service was super good, never got the name of the lady that served us but she was really nice and if she was unsure about something the head waiter was very knowledgeable and helpful.

Now to the best part, the food and wine. Nice and varied wine menu with fair prices, 72 euros for a bottle of Aalto is not to complain about even if it’s a 2023. We were also served a complimentary glass of cava which was a nice touch. We received a shot of a vegetable pure as an appetizer on the house by the kitchen. We were served bread with a lovely light tomato sauce and soft butter which was nice. Only note on that is that it would be good to inform the guest that this will be charged on the bill even if we didn’t order it, but either way it was really good. The mushroom and jamon iberico croquettes were lovely, super fresh and very flavorful. The criolle chorizo was super good and a nice starter. The Finnish Lomo Alto was superb. Nice flavour and a perfect medium rare, nice! The fries are perfect and a big portion. We also had the pineapple with coconut ice cream as a dessert which was nice and fresh.

All in all, a good price for an amazing meal and experience, I can strongly recommend this place.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAdti67xRaDCScur-KtUjkh&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-11-10"},{"Name":"Alexander Ammann","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXOG1dg0eWKF_Lql29ayxen2OynuHXLUFMB6IO2AIIFlYQDer_Y=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"A great steakhouse offering excellent value for money and fast, efficient service.
There are tables near the entrance, in the rear section, and one located downstairs. The wine and meat selection is extensive, and the portion sizes are generous. The fries are unremarkable, and vegetarian options are rather limited — this is clearly a place for meat lovers. The quality and flavor of the meat, however, are outstanding.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEI664pDT16SHsgE&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-5-13"},{"Name":"Anastasis Kouvelis","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIoo4fahaSEavpaaj5M-pRlop1hPd2OZXr2K9g4jOGKql4gWQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Very beautiful place, great atmosphere, amazing service and delicious food. The prices reflect the high quality of the restaurant and are reasonable in my opinion.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDxAwof8egzMnJMaYmd2_xH&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-12-12"},{"Name":"Pierfrancesco Manenti","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXe6UNO6m3rjNaO017xOzlqODuvEx0jJUCzEIIEZ_rhIQKNUBs=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"I had greater expectations given the good reviews. Great ambience, cool restaurant, but I was a bit disappointed, especially about the services which was closer to a tapas bar in my opinion. The main (grilled meat) arrived before the entree (grilled vegetable). Food was good but not exceptional. The grilled bread was bit burned and the meat was medium rather than medium-rare as asked. The restaura was quite big and full, so in my opinion they may need extra personnel to handle the whole thing properly","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAJHI8oSp7PpfqW_X93ecTz&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-9-18"},{"Name":"Dr. Gabriel J Martinez-Diaz, MD","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocL0n7svt7EIVBYr4eN8wgw2qkgCN01Gx6KXbrC2yLpYzNW9VVKA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Dining at Raza Madrid was an exceptional culinary experience. From start to finish, the service—led by Julia Casado—was attentive, professional, and warm, creating the perfect atmosphere for an elevated evening.

The meal was a true journey of flavors. We began with the Pan y Aperitivo and the Japanese Eggplant, both beautifully prepared and full of character. The Grilled Octopus (Pulpo a las Brasas) was a highlight—perfectly tender with a smoky finish that showed true mastery in execution. The Lomo Alto Ayrshire steak was outstanding, rich and flavorful, cooked with precision and showcasing the quality of the ingredients. The Warm Salad added a fresh and balanced note to the experience.

To complement the food, we enjoyed a bottle of La Montesa wine, which paired wonderfully with the dishes, and Água Numem Premium to round out the evening.

Every detail—from the quality of the ingredients to the pacing of the service—reflected a thoughtful approach to fine dining. I highly recommend Raza for anyone looking for a refined, modern Madrid dining experience. Booking a terrace table is well worth it, as the ambiance is elevated and inviting.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDm2gW_X6lalX6jsWDDi6Fg&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2025-8-29"},{"Name":"Hatoon G","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIenY3vQBTXY-B1oD55jzhXEPPl914WAJkaP4ZZ0vGaL2u2PQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Food was good, atmosphere is nice service however is bad but based on my experience in Madrid, Spanish waiters are not very professional
Also, the complimentary bread was added to our bill although we didn’t order it and when we asked for it to be removed, they told us, but you ate it 😂","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAfJlhZtuf9Hmx6Fc1i0kh5&fid=0x0:0xc675afe1cbccc65c"],"When":"2026-1-24"}]

Definitely one of the best spots in Madrid to enjoy real Peruvian cuisine :)","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCZryEsDLpRHZkxSWRFQxh4&fid=0x0:0xfbfc029c5dc203c4"],"When":"2025-10-22"},{"Name":"Nati","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXenLgIdMJD6V8rf3H99PdOVRZKi7ChH-17vj_R9uQstGKIpxc=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We went for the event of “Festival de la Tapa Peruana” and we got a strong pisco sour, little seco, and ceviche for 12€. The price was amazing especially for the food quality and flavor. Would totally go back.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBkm2npCq7Xo3C5R8BCizEP&fid=0x0:0xfbfc029c5dc203c4"],"When":"2025-10-4"},{"Name":"Matei Barbu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW5XF5b3E8YZeM5SFQAiIW-grfpTcaO8qlyDx5K14mLHlPCclxRpg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Last minute was trying to get some food on Friday evening at 10pm and luckily stumbled upon the Lima Limon in our area. We were a bit on the cautious side as we didn't know what to expect due to some previous reviews.

Outcome ? The food was amazing - actually exceeded our expectations. The service was fast, the food was tasty.

Our appetizers were mediocre, artichokes were oily and flavorless.
At one point we waved her down so we could order another drink and she came with an attitude, again, as if we were bothering her.

[{"Name":"Jaime Garcia Bolao","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWeYIt2uHD4lAc0XCCejO6WnkLM-HqHj29M9WWuTOy5aiVFmhSv=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"La Cocina de Frente is a quietly outstanding expression of Madrid’s culinary heritage, executed with rigor, respect, and remarkable confidence. It is a restaurant that understands tradition not as something static, but as something to be cooked with precision, patience, and conviction.

The cocido madrileño is the clearest statement of intent and the undisputed centerpiece. Served in proper sequence and without shortcuts, it is deeply flavorful, impeccably balanced, and technically exact. Each component—the broth, chickpeas, vegetables, meats—stands on its own while contributing to a cohesive whole. The broth is rich yet clean, the chickpeas tender but intact, and the meats generous without excess. It is classic cooking done properly, which is far rarer than it should be.

Beyond the cocido, the menu reflects the same philosophy: traditional Madrid dishes treated with seriousness and restraint. Flavors are honest and fully developed, relying on time, technique, and quality ingredients rather than embellishment. There is a refreshing lack of gimmickry; the kitchen’s confidence lies in execution, not reinvention.

The dining room matches the food in tone—warm, unforced, and quietly assured. Service is knowledgeable and attentive, with a clear command of the menu and a genuine respect for the dishes being served. Recommendations are thoughtful, pacing is well judged, and the overall experience feels calm and deliberate.

In a city filled with interpretations of tradition, La Cocina de Frente distinguishes itself by getting the fundamentals exactly right. It is a restaurant for those who value clarity, depth, and authenticity over spectacle. A serious address for classic madrileño cooking, and one that fully earns its reputation.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAmSAy3Z-QYGBFOEDmdPc9L&fid=0x0:0xdb94d69add2d4d78"],"When":"2025-12-30"},{"Name":"Wendy Woodman","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJa1bXs3jHypaZ7o8TwfPW8oZ76e9_AILS15uWbMoyWcaKguA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The food was amazing. We ordered five different dishes and shared them, each costing around €10. This is an unbeatable price for such exceptional quality.
The crowd is diverse, ranging from stylish young people to seniors. Everyone is welcome.

Our family, including our teenager, thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The service from Kathi and her male colleague was top-notch. They were attentive and always wore a smile, making our visit even more enjoyable.

This restaurant is my secret tip for anyone visiting Madrid. Best wishes to the fantastic team!

[{"Name":"Noam נועם Jacoby","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUM9eRbTGMgq0fT5Izl99ua8jaUD5P9xJX3yaQ245wWKTzi1AHEqg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba8-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"An amazing Neapolitan pizza in Madrid.
We started with delicious FRITTATINA CACIO E PEPE -
Pasta croquette with cacio e pepe, and the KICK was a Joselito Iberian pork on top.
After we took the PEPPE PIG pizza, with porchetta, fior di latte, crispy potatoes, Amalfi lemon zest and Dijon mustard, for me the mustard wasn’t “connected” to the pizza but my friend loved it.
Second pizza was an AMAZING BUFALA FEST - roasted San Marzano tomato sauce, mozzarella di Bufala DOP, confit tomatoes, Parmesan chips, basil pesto and lemon.
We took a good tiramisu for dessert, and 2 espresso (also one glass of wine).
The service was good.
All in all €80 for 2 persons.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDYMRS1LOw5gQsLSj2MjCb1&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2026-2-11"},{"Name":"Alvaro M. Guzman","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXofG1y5Sq1Lccb-KbBpuHXmJXXxTBhIQPSfqHcYDS9iKCKy1s9=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This is the best Italian restaurant I have visited in Madrid. The location is excellent, the ambiance is very pleasant, and the staff is outstanding. The food though truly steals the show. From the appetizers to the main courses, every dish was exceptional.

I strongly recommend making a reservation in advance. While the portion sizes for the main dishes are generous, the desserts are especially large, along with “the very important pizza” that must be share.

If you enjoy hazelnuts as much as I do, do yourself a favor and order the choco bomb, it is absolutely delicious.

Special thanks to our waiter, Marina, who provided outstanding service and made the experience even better.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCRLHF23NjLWUwgK-6kxCNv&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2025-12-18"},{"Name":"ajarni","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWy-51IAglHkw_xBGqzxEyLVIe9i9-zj3_R-5hpU9yKOHQVS__v=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We were visiting close friends and booked for a group of four for dinner. It was a very welcoming and cosy atmosphere, with beautiful decor. The live singing was a great touch to set the mood and enjoyed listening to the cover songs 🎶
We were right by the table where the chefs were cooking which was great to see them at work making and preparing dishes 👌🏿👨‍🍳
The staff were professional, very friendly and well trained - excellent service 👏🏿
We had the Bufala Fest pizza to share, it was very nice tangy taste from the confit tomatoes and lemon but balanced with the fresh mozzarella and basil pesto and the crunch of the Parmesan chips added a great touch. 🍕
I ordered the Authentic Carbonara and A far l'amore Tiramisù, great tastes but especially enjoyed the desert. My friends ordered other options, I particularly liked the presentation of the Cacio & Tartufo and how it was served directly in the Pecorino cheese wheel and moved to a serving dish
For drinks I opted for the non alcoholic cocktails; Lemonade (Sparkling water, lemon juice and cucumber-basil syrup) , favourite by far with fresh sour and sweet flavors and Casa Mia Tea (Red Berry Tea with our spice blend), bitter and sweet. 🍹","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhC0-3FDxbDf_7mZDTCVZNCi&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2025-12-10"},{"Name":"Jose V. Arcieri","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWGw07uFow31ZxQzlCBauUmU0Q9BZaxZl8UEt_g9AhZ7yHM7REkNA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"We went for lunch and really enjoyed our experience at this place. The food quality is excellent, the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the service was very good. Our waitress was attentive, kind, and made us feel comfortable throughout the meal. The ingredients tasted very fresh, and overall, the dishes were delicious.

I ordered the Bufala Fest, awarded Best Pizza in Spain, and it was outstanding, really delicious. For dessert, we had the baked profiterole filled with hazelnut ice cream, coffee praline, and melted chocolate sauce, absolutely delicious (recommended)

There are just two reasons I’m not giving 5 stars. First, I had a reservation but arrived a little late. I tried calling the restaurant to let them know, but no one answered, the phone system only sends you an automated message asking you to email them. Also, the confirmation email mentioned they would call me the same day to reconfirm, but that didn’t happen. We managed to arrive just before the 15-minute grace period, but while waiting at the door, I received an email saying my reservation had been canceled for a no-show. Thankfully, once there, they still gave us the table without any problem, but the experience wasn’t great.

The second issue was with the appetizer, the Crocchette alla Parmigiana. They were tasty and crunchy on the outside, but cold on the inside. I expected them to be served hot, so I think that could have been better.

Apart from those details, I would definitely recommend this place. The food, ambiance, and service make it a restaurant worth visiting.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDLxwis0r7K1A2YoF_IvnKY&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2025-9-26"},{"Name":"Nathan Mcluckie","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJIyjCfJSIBvTl99ZQmG_vJ1o8Tp88eNfSFP8brVlSsefn8zA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Lovely food, Great location and wonderful service, restaurant has a great atmosphere, very accommodating and english speaking!

Marina was lovely, and a great help, definitely recommend! Food was also very reasonably priced.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDPweIn9dp_zqkcMtBZk-bd&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2026-2-10"},{"Name":"Kate Choi","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU_RaUHyst7eHWrOYM_0kHeKKCiP_AMQWP9Nv6n0HpJYCgC2jjn=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Best to make a reservation- saw people who didn’t get turned away. We really enjoyed our food- carbonara, entrecôte, and bufala fest. Ended the dinner with avellana gelato. Our waitress Marina was very good!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCNrLKv0evTl-r_dNQwbNpN&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2025-12-17"},{"Name":"Jérôme","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWWl1C8-L5_xq8L7RPNAp2gscb-YucDQR8Htjaf8_7nxric1jns=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"This establishment presents itself as one of the best pizzerias in Europe, but the reality is quite disappointing.
To my surprise, some of the pizzas on the menu could not be prepared with ham because they were out of stock! How can a supposedly exceptional pizzeria lack such a basic ingredient, especially considering we are in Spain?

Even more problematic: it was impossible to request the slightest modification to an ingredient. Apparently, the kitchen is completely overwhelmed by such a simple request.
The waiter, instead of handling the situation professionally, took it personally and became upset at my entirely reasonable request.

The pizza was ok but without « Umami » and do not look like real napolitan pizza!

As for the manager, behind a falsely friendly demeanor, he gave a pretentious speech claiming that the “creativity of the kitchen” should not be questioned. As an architect, I can assure you that true creativity always comes with the ability to adapt, not rigidity.

Moreover, the manager almost forced us to eat two desserts and four limoncellos that we hadn’t ordered—perhaps assuming we weren’t full, after appetizers and pizzas?!
@manager : next time with other clients : ask before !

The sound level of the singer was too loud!

Given the widely overestimated reputation of this establishment and the deeply disappointing service, I strongly do not recommend this experience.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDxleVePP9ykfFI-JBaL5sl&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2026-1-6"},{"Name":"Luka Petrić","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW_391xkwn74mDq_VrdVmCxs_lkTtXdx7LxYr_pcaBI-J52YOs=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nice and cosy atmosphere, professional and well trained staff, super polite and helpful.
Pizzas are superb, cocktail list is unique and creative. We left the pasta for the next time.
Bufala fest is really something else.
#8 place in the world is well deserved","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAqEIh0Qq57y7S4hBQ0hrAz&fid=0x0:0x14c1c1cc72901d75"],"When":"2025-11-8"}]

[{"Name":"Aki Balogh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXs3-nASp029YT3MY4r31W8tfuZpACxMi7fPGxEmeKUvxnyhZQL-w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"For the first hour, the service was scattered. Our waiter mostly ignored us and sometimes served other tables that came after us.

The other server, Manuel, brought wine, opened it but didn’t pour it. He put it on the table with a loud thud. This was a pretty big miss, especially at this price point. I’ve never seen a waiter not want to pour out the wine.

The food was a mixed bag, but generally good. At this price point - double other restaurants - it should be. Cod croquettes were clearly an upsell, at 5 EUR each, and our server quickly pushed 6 on us. Fried artichoke was dry. Foie gras was too sweet.

Meats and fish were great, but came pretty late. These were really high quality. Secreto iberico and beef tenderloin were highlights. Turbot fish was great.

Dessert was solid. Cheesecake was worth it. In fact, they brought us a second cheesecake, which was really nice.

All-in-all, this would’ve been a solid (albeit expensive) 4/5. But I almost deducted a star because they kept pushing us to write a positive review. Manuel asked me for it twice. Then our server separately asked us for a tip. Great restaurants aren’t this pushy — they get the review based on what they deserve.

So, it’s a 4* restaurant. But they’re a bit overpriced and pushy. Don’t believe the 4.8* average.. it’s been gamed.

It’s a decent place but expect to spend 80+ EUR per person for food that you could get at probably half that price.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBGvCEibqe40ln8P7-CCY_v&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2026-1-1"},{"Name":"Michael Ng","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV7Fy--ZUmN0DeSjUAkMlt9rnUCesbjedDQMq3WIH78XwDO02uf=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Very decent and cuisines are good.  croquet is a must-order.  fish and seafood soup is spectacular.

and thanks for great hospitality of our server Samy~

will recommend our friends to visit.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCPDPIFgwMNwRnhrR-QKadh&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2026-2-16"},{"Name":"Alexandr Ale","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIC_1EWy5x92hsLxMQNlPjaDYhW06NuNHYixTDEt_wT9vy9mQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had a truly wonderful experience at this restaurant. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food combined with outstanding service. All foods are very delicious. Sammy's service was extremely warm and considerate. From the Fish/Seafood soup to the smoked sardines w/avocado to the breaded hake and crispy homemade bread, all were delicious and Michelin worthy. From the moment we made same day reservation to Ayoub’s personal service, we were treated like locals and family. Save room for dessert! Their Galician cheesecake w/mango jam and lemon sorbet w/ cava leave you wanting more! Muchisimas Gracias!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCJ1ulqfDDct0D8COExMJzg&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2025-12-27"},{"Name":"Jumie Ann Edos","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXqlB7di-abw1Cu7paxm9mUcsVKRisqK4asU8LCrmU97gR-los=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Went here with my partner and baby. This is a very child friendly environment. Service was impeccable. Food was excellent. We had the cod fritter that was full of flavor and Galician Octopus which was so tender and tasty. The callos ala madrileño was the best we've ever tried so far. As to our main entree, the iberico secreto, it was juicy, tender and cooked to perfection.

The complimentary cheesecake and lemon sorbet were divine!

Thank you very much to our very friendly and efficient server, Eloy! We will sure comeback!

Jumie & Hector","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCXP4DsmBvktBSRpLLmKdEP&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2025-10-21"},{"Name":"Moments by Robert","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV-uvEuRWcyKdQeSjlwGNXP9E_-AS4RI-IRHsnBjHJF06nN5Hg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We had an amazing experience at Los Montes de Galicia in Madrid! 🍷✨

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBDTo5952Zgyx-QgBlZwhwM&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2025-8-29"},{"Name":"GERMAN TORO","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKv54oc6YZ7U7igOqFch24QTXkOrnqlyTHTiwF8Rdo3TMxxYQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Top, very much in the top of Madrid's culinary experience.
Great is an understatement to describe the Galician food served here.
Very competent and kind staff in a very cozy decor.
All the seafood is awesome here.
Don't miss it!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA0UEVGR4iCOiLjfHmA0jNf&fid=0x0:0xeb5fa17958e1c20d"],"When":"2025-11-29"}]

I do not have a European palate therefore I felt many many dishes were overly salty or not balanced well for my palate. Maybe I’ve had too much Iberian Jamon at this stage. Many of my plates were taken away from me with food still on the plate, and as wasteful as that is, some items I simply did not wish to continue eating.

The dining experience itself was quite lovely in terms of moving through the restaurant and being immersed in different ways

Service was surprisingly a little lacking as servers weren’t sufficiently attentive,  to the standard that I would expect of a one star Michelin restaurant anyway. Actually not everyone, but the training of staff was so varied. [{"Name":"Johnny What","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXeNvymLbwdLOx3ZkV3__gKlGHDrWMCqujn8zQo9dT-D36piSaS=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nunuka cooks like it remembers something the rest of us forgot. The creamy elargi arrives molten and perfumed with chili oil, crowned with a hand-chopped tartare so fresh it feels almost illicit, a collision of heat, fat, and brightness that hits with the force of a revelation. The walnut-stuffed eggplant rolls swim in a sauce so delicate it’s practically a whisper, punctuated by pomegranate seeds that pop like tiny firecrackers of sweetness and acid. And then there’s the roasted chicken, lacquered, blistered, unapologetically juicy, soaking in a broth that tastes like someone distilled comfort and smuggled it into a Staub pan. Georgian food in Madrid shouldn’t be this soulful, this confident, this transcendent, but here it is. Nunuka might very well be the best restaurant in the city, and nights like this make you believe in culinary miracles.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDHdGJhZKRGxXcUa3nP8QFI&fid=0x0:0x9a30ddddc8aadaa9"],"When":"2025-12-16"},{"Name":"Christina E.","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJPP9hZGsvFCsMNPQQ_4LJRwPF-HD_Klduc_S5VNVnrn2HS7A=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"While visiting Spain we found ourselves in need of a change of flavor from all the tapas and paella. After looking around the area online we found Nunuka, having never tried Georgian food before we were excited to give it a try. We walked in late afternoon to an empty restaurant, I think they were closed between lunch and dinner. However they graciously allowed us to sit down. Thank God they did! We ordered a few items nervous to try so many new things- we LOVED them all! By the time we left we had tried almost half the menu- each dish better than the last! The sever was patient with our best attempts to pronounce the dishes and her table side preparations only added to the experience. The space is beautifully decorated and so intimate. I cannot recommend stopping here for a meal enough","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDP9QxTyuulOgF-1WV2s_Sr&fid=0x0:0x9a30ddddc8aadaa9"],"When":"2025-10-10"},{"Name":"Nicole Taylor","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLp-3HMqqgtk4eKJGD-n4xDUCPN0Ow9c2BcsDeQSooEZ9w4sA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Everything that we ate was absolutely delicious! Simply amazing food.

The Adjaruli Khachapuri was the best I had in my life, the cheese, the texture of the bread just perfect.

We order the 3 Khinkali, the best one for my tast was the ones with meat, but the mushroom ones also amazing.

Goos selection of Georgians wines, not easy to find in Europe in general.

Hope the service get better, was really bad honestly for a restaurant that has a Michelin guide recommendation.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBDV0UoSLSuLmSgFjfxC2wb&fid=0x0:0x9a30ddddc8aadaa9"],"When":"2025-10-21"},{"Name":"Vicente Rueda","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXFBFJ8dNe_2-DAUfNNl8TaJrvy3iZK09VuLSKCdhVlJXvP6BHS=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Amazing Georgian restaurant with great cuisine and polite service. Having never tried, or really didn’t know anything about Georgian cuisine I was a bit nervous but everything I got was beautifully cooked, complete flavour bombs and oh so creative!

I forgot to take pictures of the starter, some soup dumplings, and the main course, turkey cannelloni, but I took a picture of the beautiful carrot cake :)","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBJWTqgjTW-lSyNp8ClzleV&fid=0x0:0x9a30ddddc8aadaa9"],"When":"2025-8-26"},{"Name":"Marco Menzhausen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV5ksm-P-HLcuvgTBnFt3_htHZmd6SxaS1rMeuwIuL0Y9Q0_bCI=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My first time eating at a restaurant in Georgia, and it completely exceeded my expectations. - The host went the extra mile to squeeze us in a bit earlier than our reservation (thank you ♥️)
- Our waiter was attentive, fun, effective (really knew the menu and set us up with great recs ✨)
- Co-sign all the recommendations already mentioned in reviews: torrezno, oxtails, french toast
- The lentil soup is the unsung hero 🙌🏽
- Go with the scallop over the oyster

Will certainly be back!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA6WAi_DRNKiTwW9v88cVKy&fid=0x0:0xf8a9e2fa482a6661"],"When":"2025-12-4"},{"Name":"Michele","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLECiaFNKydQm1MeAMyX7TY0F7SEgb5_jgN5hP8SPlfPgWJrg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I visited an excellent restaurant in Madrid last August, and I have very fond memories of the experience. The service was impeccable: attentive, courteous, and always professional. The cuisine offers traditional Spanish dishes reinterpreted in a modern way, without unnecessary frills, but with great attention to the quality of the ingredients. The wine selection is also remarkable.

The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, perfect for a pleasant and relaxed dinner. It’s the kind of restaurant you can visit often because it combines good food, excellent wine, and a welcoming environment.

The experience was very satisfying: the dishes were well-executed, with high-quality products. Some dishes impressed me more than others, but that comes down to personal taste.

Overall, it was a memorable dinner that will remain one of the best memories of my summer holidays.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICP9N2EmAE&fid=0x0:0xf8a9e2fa482a6661"],"When":"2024-11-22"},{"Name":"Miss V","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJ7hGdgwJFx919GDKs87niu014Fl200olPzGxivLLZ1_y4G8Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"(Visited on 29th May 2025)

This was my second time visiting the restaurant. The first time was amazing—everything was spot-on, and I left really impressed. But sadly, my second visit was a huge letdown.

The service was terrible. Our waiter was cold and condescending—no greeting, no smile, nothing. It honestly felt like he just wanted us to hurry up, eat, and leave. At one point, they even took my plate away while I was still eating.

The staff were also super loud when putting away the dishes, banging things around, which made the whole place feel more like a noisy diner than a nice restaurant. Definitely not the kind of atmosphere you'd expect at this price point.

The only positive was that the food still tasted good. But with so many great places to eat in Madrid, this just isn’t worth it anymore. I won’t be coming back.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBkidi23diRnq38g0cM4w81&fid=0x0:0xf8a9e2fa482a6661"],"When":"2025-6-21"},{"Name":"Coco A","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIalt-bNSDrfYHY6jDG9H1u1NXgzsGgkbs1dGTZX2_n_dGCT_g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"From service to meal, I enjoyed a lot.
Thanks to Henry for the attentive service, for the recommendations.

[{"Name":"Everyone’s Connoisseur","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW8eXNeWzb1lqLrwaBK_tmHc_-nykIs6CMJGs5GhSn6WZb3GMY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"Chambao!
An Ibiza-vibe steakhouse with live performances. Guitar and violin are played at intervals, while the lights dim and brighten again.

At first glance, the interior looks upscale, but once you sit down, you start to feel that the furniture isn’t as special as it initially appears. You order the waiter-recommended pear salad, which turns out to be average. Then you order the 1.5 kg rib-eye: tasty, good quality, and juicy. Very good, actually, but not top-notch.

You order several sides that sound more promising than they taste: some kind of potato dish, smashed truffle potatoes, and mushrooms. Afterwards, you tell the waiter it’s your friend’s birthday (a small lie), and he brings a chocolate cake for free, complete with a little show. Finally, you order the chocolate variation dessert, where everything has the same flavor but a different texture.

It’s the perfect place for a one-night-stand date, as any meaningful or valuable conversation gets interrupted every 10–15 minutes by the live performances anyway.

The bill is surprising: more paid than it was worth.
My friend liked the female violin player.
I don‘t like that you are kind of kicked out after your 2 hour table slot expires.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDD8fNQyOTSVxYqMcPL2-9E&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-12-20"},{"Name":"Iordanis Paraskevas","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIl2A3wAlQ-bMizhVHd0C6a04176wMyHqxcsLwR9YytOxT-1g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Among the best places I have been ever. It is not just the food, which is good but not the best for me, but the overall setup, presentation and atmosphere. Portions were proper, cooking of the beef as requested. Only the desert left us rather in different. The best part was the guitarist, who apoeared in intervals to remain interesting and was accompanying the music. I would definitely visit again if I ever go to Madrid. Prices above average as expected, but worth it.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA1EpHpBWpVTN9xQ5nA_Uhp&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-12-20"},{"Name":"Thad Russell","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU-ELMg8Pa-_-JNwI-cRKOQp0vk5-1xn_Uf55tix4jzp5COFTU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Love this place. Top 3 ever dining experiences. I’ve been to a dozen countries and 48 US states and this was one of my very favorites. Great vibe and atmosphere. The staff were fabulous and the food was perfect. But for a steakhouse to have a live DJ… moved it over the top. At one point they had half the restaurant erupting in the chorus with almost as many dancing in their chairs. All happening at a very proper, high-end steakhouse. Thank you for the forever memory. I will forever recommend and will make it a consistent stop whenever we’re in Madrid.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAeDryHbHGzsF1xGpcgU5zO&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-12-25"},{"Name":"Shaun Rawls","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVcIEORvKCfTRdXzbCHclvxeiGGqb7sLQxKzT2a1jU3T5Dvwc-Pnw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Very cool place. Different dining experience, for sure. Sexy atmosphere, cool musical enhancements, although at times was way too loud. I thought the flaming table side steak was overrated, but the burger was fantastic! Friendly staff and if you are into hooka, people seemed to enjoy that. I think it's a cool place to go to, although I wouldn't feel compelled to go back.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCZZNPXzkgHbDdG5dooSEP0&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-10-26"},{"Name":"Tatiana Gonçalves","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXCICU_8F_if2_ixFWtVQBWY33nbf_UUBYoMctObUbrYPhTmKz2=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Chambao Madrid is a stunning restaurant with impressive décor and a captivating atmosphere. The food is truly delicious, beautifully presented, and definitely worth the visit. The only area that could be improved is the service — at times we were left waiting quite a while before someone came to assist us. Overall, it’s a great spot for a special night out, with the potential to be even better with more attentive and timely service.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAdQoBX8Uw37DM_jcEXNPvn&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-10-15"},{"Name":"Atilla Eymen Kanmaz","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXcpj71-51z6XvlaegPa-0h9pboB3D0WD1wB5YzSf7D24Zw4B7b=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"It’s a lively steakhouse with upbeat music and a joyful atmosphere. While enjoying your meal, you can also watch small entertaining shows, which make the experience more fun. The food is decent, but the lively ambiance and performances add great value to the place.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCCtu-fUmCa9Uj8N6YIffwA&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-9-18"},{"Name":"Rbrt Prt","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX8BHBdWNZXKPQaXOUxe76bmkuxcbp70M--uDM9-cDamNOaqx97=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"This restaurant is more like a show than an actual culinary experience. Every dish you order is an occasion for the waiters to do some kind of trick with fire - which after a while gets pretty annoying. The meat is nothing special, just overpriced. Very nice guitar show which keeps you entertained. At the end of the dinner the waitress tried to fight with us cause we wanted to split the bill in 4 people, which ultimately destroyed our mood. Interesting experience but not worth the 90 eur we spent per person (without alcohol).","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhB_VQTD0tTpoBSM5w4dEjiH&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-9-24"},{"Name":"Diana T","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUo8TzX8uv_T-c3Ma8p3vg4uwY24s4tGszHU7LetT1d69uuAxjg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We had one of the best dining experiences in Madrid at Chambao. From the moment we walked in, the vibe was just right, warm lighting, stylish decor, and live music that made the whole place feel alive without being overwhelming. It felt like the kind of spot where you could celebrate something special or just treat yourself to a great night out.

The food was genuinely amazing. The octopus was hands down one of the best I’ve ever had, so tender, with just the right smoky flavor. And the Magna Cake was just wow, rich, velvety, and somehow not too heavy

What really made the evening stand out was the service. Everyone was so welcoming and attentive, but in a relaxed, friendly way. You could tell they cared about the experience, not just the food","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDOSGJon-P0Em7LsvC3hL7P&fid=0x0:0x8f6fb1e5c0eb9df1"],"When":"2025-8-14"}]

Las croquetas de cecina y parmesano tan ricas y cremosas que habría pedido 2 raciones más, igual que la tarta de queso que se me hizo pequeña. Durante toda la comida no faltaron rapidez y detalles. She recommended some dishes that were both delicious and refreshing, and they weren't necessarily the most expensive items on the menu, which is always a plus.

I ordered the traditional pork belly dish called torreznos, and it was absolutely amazing. The pork was cooked to perfection and was one of the best pork belly dishes I've ever had. The grilled avocados were also extremely delicious and perfectly seasoned.

Although we sat inside, the atmosphere was cozy, modern, and very nice. The decor and ambiance were both great, and the restaurant had a warm and welcoming feeling.

Overall, Mercado de Ibiza is a fantastic restaurant that I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a great meal in Madrid. Great food, great cocktails and great service. I have to give them a shout out as it’s the first time I’ve truly had craft cocktails and I’ve been in Europe since 9/5, bouncing between countries.

Now ,for the facts. There’s a stuffy restaurant upstairs and an awesome speakeasy downstairs where you can get great cocktails and food. Granted it’s a smaller menu than what’s offered upstairs, but was fine on my solo visit.

Make sure you make reservations!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDOx47azHIxkstG0P-LuSop&fid=0x0:0x73f9d03c5fe29da"],"When":"2025-8-27"},{"Name":"Anton S.","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUWwYyXm9QC53xdcYQo-cbblrDEM65S8LQ4a-wTQnPh1lJMK5pA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba8-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Atmosphere: 7.5/10 Japanese-themed downstairs, mellow but upbeat. Music volume is good. Seating includes bar spots and some tables for groups. Located in the basement level of Angelita Wine Bar & Restaurant. Design shows solid craftsmanship and refined attention to detail.

Drinks: 9/10 Recommendation: Raspberry & Flowers (for summer), Peppers & Eggplant Menu is high quality, with flavor-profile diagrams for guidance. Large selection. Flavors are well balanced. Coasters are present. Glassware is above average, with unique touches like double-wall cooling glasses. Garnishes are creative, and overall presentation—including ice work—is strong.

Service: 9.5/10 Water on arrival, plus complimentary snacks. Team is friendly, professional, and highly attentive. No reservations needed. Prices are average.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCxsML0lRuHv4pBq31dDH5h&fid=0x0:0x73f9d03c5fe29da"],"When":"2025-10-12"},{"Name":"Season Chan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV4a2OyaQCcAUsVFrhQX3cpm51esh3P8B3PY2URf27eN0rMQBNN=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Angelita was such a pleasant surprise — delicious in the most impressively simple way. Every dish we had was fresh, honest, and full of flavor without trying too hard.

We started with what might be the craziest tomato salad I’ve ever had — incredibly fresh, beautifully balanced, and prepared in the simplest way possible. Then came the ratatouille, which completely changed my mind about the dish. I was never a fan before, but Angelita’s version truly blew me away — full of depth and flavor.

We finished off with the steak tartare, which was absolutely spot-on — perfectly seasoned and so satisfying. Among the three of us, we shared a bottle of white wine that paired beautifully with everything.

People were also raving about their cocktails, which we didn’t get to try this time — but it gives me the perfect excuse to come back. Next time, I’ll definitely be sitting at the bar to explore their cocktail menu","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD2w0cEfZUerGBsBj8kqW4K&fid=0x0:0x73f9d03c5fe29da"],"When":"2025-10-12"},{"Name":"Courtney Marino","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVLsP7gV_uvhziE73LKAN54HOVk7SNTj0EJp3qNOLU2MK1VZ5Dh=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Blown away with our experience here. Can’t wait to come back","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAyuf2MbU6DTnhFYuGgOPfs&fid=0x0:0x73f9d03c5fe29da"],"When":"2025-11-16"},{"Name":"Julianne Chifos","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUW5k6WWLmtISj4SXAZtaAxL8QGta1gBD8kJiCIdAl7Wkg6iqlL=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This place was delicious in impressively simple ways. Do not miss eating here if you’re visiting Madrid - Thank you, Yadira and Nelson for such great service and an enjoyable afternoon.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDIjl066Bire-e7yNp6wzCX&fid=0x0:0x1e677321b4210280"],"When":"2025-10-17"},{"Name":"Whitney Andrews","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX-V7LhPWKIaIk7xTnhbjYM1lrcw7Jjj9Ot2AD_0sXJrniQfYps=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"After seeing photos of their paella, I knew I had to try this place, and it did not disappoint. The paella was incredible: flavorful, perfectly cooked with that delicious crispy rice, everything you’d hope for. We also tried a local jamón appetizer, which was excellent. While we didn’t sample much else, the menu is quite extensive, so there’s something for everyone.

The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, making for a lovely setting, and it’s located on a charming, picturesque street, perfect if you’re exploring Madrid. Service was a bit on the colder side, but still efficient. Overall, we really enjoyed our meal and would recommend it, especially for the paella.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAsS74m6uVfnY8EAdUaSA7V&fid=0x0:0x1e677321b4210280"],"When":"2025-9-12"},{"Name":"sharon shmueli","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI8JtB0ukumvsX2PLd4vfMyms-83M8QbS_tbZFzL5xEcThWUw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Reserved a table as very busy place but very large restaurant. They are very busy and although the food was excellent the service was not, at least not for us as non Spanish speaking. The shrimps arrived first and were delicious then we waited for a while for the scallops which again were amazing.
Then after a while came the almost cold very good mushed potatoes on its on. Then we waited a very long time for the roasted vegetables. So the food was excellent the service was not.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDeO1LxZgpjosDEAuc2d3vU&fid=0x0:0x1e677321b4210280"],"When":"2025-9-29"},{"Name":"Aneesh Vaghadia","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLWrL7cKUXjPtxgV-J_aqDc0U8QhiCuyIUBtGHmUeqQs8V-GQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This restaurant is amazing!! We were a bit hesitant that it might be tourist focused since many of the staff speak English and they play a lot of English songs, but it was definitely not the case.  The service is excellent.  We would strongly recommend reservations because they were full on both nights.  Of course, the paella is a must try.  The octopus was also magnificent.  The texture was perfect. We arrived in Madrid on our first night looking for a nice restaurant. At Taberna de Penalver Callao we had a few starters, and tried crusted rice (lovely but not what we expected), all tasted great. It wasn’t cheap, but we both enjoyed the food and wine. One small point, the music was English pop, something more authentic would better suit the decor.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAbMATT341CoM8kuMvHpvHR&fid=0x0:0xed1c62c433e4dd1e"],"When":"2026-1-12"},{"Name":"SJD","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI9X6OLG47nzGcYdXxqlai4KcGhLNHIU2WRtV_dHPkvJcq8Gg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I visited as a solo traveler and overall had a good experience. Just a heads-up for fellow solo diners: their paella portions are priced per person, but they only serve a minimum of two, so you’ll be charged for two even if you’re dining alone.

That said, the Gentleman’s Paella was really delicious, and the shrimp al ajillo was flavorful and well cooked. Bathrooms look awesome, but there wasn't any paper to dry your hands 😢 . The surtido ibérico was great but there wasn't any jamón (only lomo, salchichón and chorizo), would have expected to get some of that too...","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBIqh1n1SmGi6jv__XZz8H1&fid=0x0:0xed1c62c433e4dd1e"],"When":"2025-12-9"},{"Name":"Ana Ababei","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI8KWXq0VwLJ1ZzRLjElUabsIPuL75LtnC1mK1r0f_J-spCMQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I ordered the seafood paella and it was absolutely delicious — especially with a squeeze of extra lemon. She also suggested a digestive, crema de orujo (similar to Baileys), which was the perfect finishing touch.

Overall, it was an amazing experience. Even the "spiciest" salsa they served probably had half the scoville score of Tapatio or Cholula. Also, air conditioning was too strong and the place was cold in excess ( and I am american, so I know a/c) inprove lighting at the back","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD-OY95JbJXVRjXo9ob0rE_&fid=0x0:0xb429ee281ee83be6"],"When":"2025-8-31"},{"Name":"Marco P","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLH8BAELvUkPFcPl-VfdkEIQimgh2dqJdtXuOY3hqP20d8UeAU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"It’s hard to put into words how incredible this place is. The service was good and attentive.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAgqiblFa8hJMTuHT6MpBOS&fid=0x0:0xe2c70b0e0183cbf6"],"When":"2025-10-15"},{"Name":"Predrag P","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJZUfu4Okiu4GfpnBcw5XgHfUGh_0tH6i--DfLyUrI3Y6GMCw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Dining at Deessa is less a meal and more a carefully choreographed performance — one where even the smallest gestures are elevated into rituals of refinement.
The service choreography deserves special mention. Black napkins are offered so that guests never feel self-conscious when wiping their lips; each time you step away to the restroom, your napkin is quietly replaced with a fresh one. Even the transition from savory to sweet is executed with precision: water glasses are changed so that no lingering flavor interferes with the final act of the menu. These seemingly subtle details reveal the philosophy of a restaurant where elegance lies in discretion.
The wine pairing begins not with the very first bites but from the caviar course — a detail that would have been good to know from the outset. Yet, this was more than compensated by the sommelier’s presence: he offered precise, insightful explanations of each pairing, carefully tuned to my sensibilities, while maintaining a natural warmth and ease. Alongside him, the entire team radiated attentiveness and genuine smiles, which allowed me to fully enjoy the three-hour gastronomic journey without a single moment of stiffness.
As for the menu itself, it is a masterclass in cultural reinterpretation. The “gilda with cockles”, a playful twist on one of the Basque Country’s most iconic pintxos, preserves the salty-spicy audacity of the original while elevating it with the mineral freshness of cockles. A bite that is bold, elegant, and unmistakably sophisticated.

The savory “crème brûlée with roasted onions, toasted pork, and seasonal mushrooms” is another standout: a french classic reimagined into a silken umami custard, layered with caramelized onion sweetness, earthy mushroom depth, and smoky pork crunch. A familiar form that startles the palate with unexpected strength and refinement.
Equally memorable, the “cold beetroot and dill soup with kefir ice cream and salmon”, transforms rustic Eastern European roots into a luxurious fine-dining prelude — vibrant in color, refreshing in taste, and strikingly elegant. The “Ritz caviar and cured roe selection” pays tribute to the legacy of the Ritz while displaying Quique Dacosta’s devotion to purity of product, while the “coastal oyster and sea cracker” crowned with sea urchin infusion, becomes a true homage to the ocean: briny, creamy, mineral, and profound.
Further along the journey, the “rice with dry octopus” resonates with Mediterranean tradition, its umami intensity layered over perfectly cooked grains, while the “duck from Albufera to Madrid” bridges rustic Valencian heritage with the cosmopolitan grace of the capital — a dish as cultural as it is culinary, and one of the finest duck preparations I have experienced.
Desserts bring poetry rather than indulgence. “The Pine” evokes a forest on the palate, more sensory landscape than sweet, while the “chocolate berliner with iced vanilla powder” plays with memory and contrast — a childhood pastry transformed into a luxurious balance of warmth and coolness, richness and airiness.
Deessa is not about extravagance but about narrative: tradition reframed through luxury, nature distilled into fine dining, and hospitality expressed through detail. With a team that embodies both professionalism and warmth, and a menu that alternates between cultural homage and avant-garde creativity, Deessa offers a gastronomic journey that is elegant, intelligent, and deeply memorable.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAILeKNV7OMjPw8c5H8PJkf&fid=0x0:0xe2c70b0e0183cbf6"],"When":"2025-9-5"},{"Name":"Gisel Kautz","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV0Yz1ZHwG5nhBwfZQJy0L717LghRVkMEZpsN-gh2w5PXq5vQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Wow—where to begin? Dining at Deessa was nothing short of unforgettable. From the moment we walked in, we were immersed in an atmosphere of refined elegance and exceptional attention to detail. The décor is stunning, the ambiance sophisticated yet welcoming, and the service flawless—attentive without ever feeling intrusive.

Every dish we tasted was a masterpiece: the duck, the caviar, the beet soup, even the bread—each one beautifully presented and perfectly executed. The cocktails were just as thoughtfully crafted, a perfect complement to the meal.

What truly set the evening apart, though, was the warmth and thoughtfulness of the staff. We were celebrating my mother’s birthday, and they went above and beyond—surprising her with a cake and flowers that made the evening even more special.

Deessa is not just a restaurant—it’s an experience. We’ll cherish this meal for a long time, and we can’t wait to return.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEM2Ttrf7k8_eeA&fid=0x0:0xe2c70b0e0183cbf6"],"When":"2025-5-29"},{"Name":"Justin Mak","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJiR60r14yZ39PrucpSmipVgJJtBR5kIVqpX-rOrsLTEm_EaRq6=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Had an impeccable lunch here at Deessa.

We ordered the Chronus Lunch Menu, which allows us to choose our own dishes, and it was well worth it for an experience at a Michelin 2-Star restaurant. The food presented flavors that one never knew exist and surprised us in terms of their presentation and complexity from the hors d’oeuvre to the petits fours. I, for one, find the sweetbread well roasted and couldn’t get enough of it. The bread was also crunchy and tastes amazing.

The wine recommended was also extraordinary, we had an incredible Ferreiro and a graceful Tesalia which matched perfectly with the dishes.

The service was also on par with the restaurant’s prestige, as the sommelier and the waiting staff explained patiently the wines and the ingredients of the dishes, answering all our questions. They also took great care to make sure the tablecloth was spotless and the glasses filled, giving their best for our experience.

The environment didn’t disappoint either, for it was one of the reason we chose to come. The dining hall was well lit and decorated in a classical style, reminding guests of a luxurious palace. The French windows opening to the garden also let in a lot of natural light, bathing diners in the mild sunlight of springtime. The tables and seatings were adequately spaced, which shows their utmost attention to their guests comfort and privacy.

I will definitely come again should I visit Madrid again.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMDo69HfowE&fid=0x0:0xe2c70b0e0183cbf6"],"When":"2025-4-29"},{"Name":"Ln. We dine here as a big group and they served us nicely from entree to dessert. As an Asian customer eating here, I’m happy that the taste of food was really fusing the original freshness or ingredient (taste light) and the use of seasoning & spices (taste moderate) gave me a wonderful meal which I don’t feel I’m too far from home and craving for heavy taste food.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMDo7YevxgE&fid=0x0:0xf2bacefb7378b28e"],"When":"2025-4-27"},{"Name":"Kissairis Basora M","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVnmNShx9G6QX3O5fLqSDU9xn1YabPRtXIbQ_i8KUPAphEpXZ8G-g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I visited Raimunda back in 2022, and even though some details have faded with time, the overall experience left a lasting impression.

Despite arriving without a reservation and finding the place fully booked, the staff kindly found us a spot at the bar — a gesture that speaks volumes about their excellent service and attention to guests. From there, we enjoyed delicious food in a vibrant, elegant setting that beautifully blends classic charm with a modern touch.

The ambiance was lively yet relaxed, and the atmosphere made it easy to enjoy the moment. The service was top-notch — friendly, attentive, and welcoming from start to finish.

It’s one of those places where the experience stays with you, even years later. I’d happily go back to relive it all again.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMCoy9brtwE&fid=0x0:0xf2bacefb7378b28e"],"When":"2025-4-19"},{"Name":"P Pezza","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLkuK9CfmrAxC72uAc-YjoiZ86svh7Kq0sRYJolv6RZPrbPVCD4=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The best pork tenderloin I’ve had in my life. We don’t speak Spanish, but despite this the staff was very friendly and patient. I don’t think I can ever order pork again in the US without being disappointed.
Sorry about the photo, but I started eating before stopping to take a photo and post this wee-deserved review.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAQfgscAd_PBKe_ij7lZtEh&fid=0x0:0xf2bacefb7378b28e"],"When":"2025-7-10"},{"Name":"Rafael Alvarez","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU-MWp3ePx-musiAZ9k32SYYqw587K30ZYQ0bYTtAKaZb2Wr9Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Raimunda is a real gem nestled in the lush garden of the Casa de América, an elegant escape right by the Palace of Linares. The ambiance is calm, leafy, and effortlessly chic—perfect for escaping city noise and enjoying a relaxed meal outdoors.  ￼

The cuisine blends Mediterranean roots with vibrant Ibero-American touches. We shared a few small dishes—chewy, golden patatas hojaldadas con salsa, fresh ceviche de corvina con mango, and rich lasagna de rabo de toro—each plate was beautifully presented with well-balanced flavors and quality ingredients.  ￼ ￼ Cocktails were a highlight too, inventive and well-crafted.  ￼ ￼

Service was attentive and warm, adding to the relaxed yet refined mood of the evening. Though the restaurant’s popularity means it can get busy, the pace never feels rushed—even when the garden fills with diners.  ￼ ￼

All in all, Raimunda offers a memorable mix of polished atmosphere, creative food, and oasis-like surroundings. It’s a beautiful choice for a special dinner or a leisurely meal with friends in Madrid’s heart.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBp3NU-6eG6-FBGfbCYn9i4&fid=0x0:0xf2bacefb7378b28e"],"When":"2025-9-8"},{"Name":"Robert Soler","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUZVR537r-_DOwrdXRuvYlour4L4F8x7CzQTl63O7Ps5JXIEBxXaw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"This place has a nice atmosphere, and the food was much better on our previous visit. Unfortunately, it seems there’s been a change in management or ownership because this experience was extremely disappointing — and I left feeling cheated.

We ordered the Oxtail Lasagna and the Argentinian Rib-Eye, listed at $24.99. The waiter mentioned the Rib-Eye was “big enough for two,” but I responded that I’d be the judge of that. My wife and I decided to share both dishes along with some bread and bottled water. When the bill arrived, we were shocked to see we’d been charged $48 for the Rib-Eye — apparently because we “shared it.”

I asked for clarification multiple times, but the explanations were vague and evasive. It’s clear this is a tactic aimed at taking advantage of tourists. Locals might be able to challenge it, but if you’re visiting, beware — you may not have the same leverage. Tourists, stay away! This place preys on visitors, and I wouldn’t want anyone else to fall victim to this kind of scam.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICv0r_XlwE&fid=0x0:0xf2bacefb7378b28e"],"When":"2024-12-9"}]

[{"Name":"Dee Dee","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW2zeDsxs5USnA0hJvmdoxqdvaivzHS8doGrhi2XbOmK27_CsuL=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I am so upset that I have to write this review & say what I’m about to say…

I had passed SteakBurger Bar earlier in the day & decided to come back & get dinner.

I went in at 6.50pm.

Something was going on…I followed the server towards the bar, he then spoke to a lady server & then I was escorted back in the direction I just came from, he looked quite stressed.

I was seated & a few minutes later the lady server came & took my drinks order & told me to scan the qr code for the menu. She returned with my drink reasonably quickly.

Meanwhile, 3 members of staff were opposite me with 2 customers & they were watching something on, I think, a phone. They looked quite serious.
Anyway, no one came back to take my order within the next 22 minutes.
If I didn’t order that drink I would’ve left!

I attempted to get 4 different servers attention during that time.

Eventually, I managed to get the attention of a young man from the bar, who took my order.

My order was delivered approximately 15 minutes later but I was given the wrong order. I asked for a medium to well done steak & I was accidentally given a rare one. The server took it back & returned promptly with the correct steak. I just hoped that he hadn’t given my food to someone else & taken it back but I’ll never know.

The steak was slightly over done but it was ok. At least I knew it was cooked. The chips were good & the green pepper things were lovely. Back to the steak…It had a massive section of gristle running along on side which was inedible. The meal also had sea salt added to all of it. I do not know if this is customary here in Madrid but it may be an issue for some people.

I finished my meal at 7.40pm & the plate was taken at & my plate was taken about 5 minutes later. I wasn’t asked if I wanted dessert at this time. He just took it and left.

I then had to again try to grab someone’s attention to order dessert.
I managed to get the handsome young one’s attention again & he came and attempted to take my order. His English is good but not brilliant, I can’t complain as I don’t speak any Spanish. Anyway, I had to refer to the menu on my phone for him to understand me.
Shortly after, the lady server, trotted past me and asked if I wanted the bill. I then explained that I was waiting on dessert. Considering, she was supposed to be my server, it would’ve been nice if she had offered dessert or asked how was my meal.

Dessert was delivered promptly with a teaspoon. I again, do not know if this is customary here, but I would’ve hoped for a dessert spoon,  but dessert tasted fine.

The young server then came back & I requested the bill and paid without tipping.

PLEASE NOTE- I NORMALLY TIP BUT THE SERVICE HERE IS SHOCKINGLY BAD!

The young server then came back over to me and asked me if my food was ok? Or something along those lines.
“I said it was ok “ but I shouldn’t have said that but I was over the whole experience and just wanted to go.

I can honestly say, I will never come to this establishment again!

Ps. I’m not sure but the customers that I mentioned in the beginning, I think they had something stolen as they went over to a table near the door with staff members & we’re talking. I heard something about a coat.
Again, patrons were being neglected by staff who were talking to them & some were just watching.

Please note- One member of senior staff should’ve been allocated to this incident not whoever was interested.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBV2o3HCTFBfCMoH90rvuCT&fid=0x0:0x7c7443d79b8af266"],"When":"2026-1-13"},{"Name":"Caroline Lockhart","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJWM4Uaw90IoawsqYpgyJC94rwOi1eu-Z8iWILF9Rue-UrcYQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The food was absolutely amazing—every dish was bursting with flavor and perfectly prepared. [{"Name":"selma","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIVTUVJoEQC3HrdEZBEPGRogb2Dl3BFlF-7-2wztn_CDMFb3Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This was my first time visiting, and I was truly impressed. Although it’s located on a main street, the atmosphere inside is calm, quiet, and very peaceful. Whether you come for tea, coffee, or a full meal, the service is well structured and adapted to your choice.
The kitchen is fully visible through a wall-to-wall open window, which creates a strong sense of transparency. The staff working inside were clean, quiet, and highly disciplined, which inspires confidence. Orders are taken by female staff who were extremely polite, gentle, and attentive. Overall, the environment is serene — people naturally lower their voices while talking.
In the restroom, I noticed a small but meaningful detail: a woman carefully folding the cloth hand towels, clearly taking great pride in her work. We made eye contact, I smiled and said “gracias.” That brief moment made me feel that this place truly values attention, care, and human effort.
Cleanliness, order, and a sense of calm come together here to create a refined and genuinely pleasant experience.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD43FBrcm3BVCjgzI0fOyqi&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2026-2-12"},{"Name":"joaquin ANNOCARO","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJsLNedLnqkZ_chQZeZOCmXx-HwmFB-TvPpIwg2znQXsDW4wg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I am not used to write reviews but this time I have to say that the whole experience was one of a kind. From the quality of the food to the service and the atmosphere. The food is very generous and prices are very fair. 100% recommend. Thank you to Angelica for the service ❤️","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAbB-IBxoDu0BBxvnYJKSTj&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2026-1-21"},{"Name":"LOIS R. Just as we were impressed with the food quality at breakfast, our dinner was one of the most satisfying meals we had on a European trip. This even surpassed a Parisian meal I’ve had in Paris, with no exaggeration. We travel often and we always want to try good food. Both my son and I agree on the richness of the flavors, the beautiful presentations, and the delicious taste of this dinner. Kudos to our server Angelica, who did an excellent job recommending our drinks and food orders. 👍🏻👍🏻🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhB6pstE_ZRg-Q7gQhZxApWC&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2025-9-6"},{"Name":"Bertrand Levy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJe8QrJyxPImBGL4gLlyCnNKoic43i5Li3wgpF1KIduuXUEVQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The cocktails at Braque are absolutely incredible. You can feel the work of true professionals — every balance, every detail is thought through to perfection. And yet, despite this level of mastery, the vibe stays effortlessly relaxed. That rare mix of flawless technique and genuine coolness. Exactly what I love: when craftsmanship meets ease.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDaOB_hj2jPvVMdjbnFbjIV&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2025-11-11"},{"Name":"Bob Parker","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXfPXfTzEWVaH6NbQyR9TntuI0JDqBrkp8JtwGodogJnx6Fz6jP=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The overall experience was wonderful. We booked the 'private' room as we were 6 people; however, we were seated in the main dinning area. This was not a problem. The reason for booking the  'private' room was due to the restaurant being somewhat narrow and we wanted to make sure we were not cramped. We sat with 3 tables pulled together on the wall and it was perfectly fine, plenty of room for our party to enjoy each other's company. The group tried multiple dishes. For starters we had the Babaganoush ahumado al Josper - FANTASTIC, the Pimientos del padrón - great, Oven roasted cauliflower, tahini sauce - FANTASTIC (the tahini sauce was amazing), and the Baby gem lettuce with botarga, parmesan and citrus vinaigrette. This was enough for the 6 of us. For dinner, two of us had the Bacalao confitado, mariscos, jugo de bouillabaisse, it was good; however, not my favorite as the bouillabaisse sauce just did not hit the mark for me (a little too creamy, not a fish broth, missing the orange/golden-hued color from the saffron/tomato). Two split the Lenguado entero asado, salsa Grenobloise, one had Suprema de pollo con polenta cremosa, salsa gremolada, and the last had Carrillera de black angus, jugo de carne, puerro confitado - very rich (I had a bite, it was great). And finally, dessert - also AMAZING - each of us had a different selection. The wine list is extensive, a lot of great French wines (what you would expect). We look forward to eating here again, and absolutely want to experience their brunch.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"X Z","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI5DXAaO_doVbfunmt930YxVGg2RIyjnqB7M_MQh62eDixOuA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Cozy place for dinner or coffee. My parents and I visited here twice and 💯.

Highly recommend their roasted cauliflower and tuna salad. No words to describe. Must try.

Desserts are ok but the cappuccino is perfect.

Special thanks to the two ladies served us, they’re very professional and kind. My bad for not asking their names.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDzVKxj4wFwhjPpaV4EnZFj&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2025-12-22"},{"Name":"Nicole & Justin Shively","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKG6sV1QgUiJUSW6SWsfWMcfNDJpgYbZfiOVb5BFGvHmoWO5g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"First time visiting Madrid and we found this bar to have drinks. There are bartenders and there are Mixologists - José from Brach Madrid was the latter and this place was amazing. Hands down one of the best bars I have been to in Europe. Had 4 specialty drinks total, 3 of these were on the menu: Chueca, Gran Via and Segovia - all Tequila or Mezcal forward concoctions. For the 4th I asked José to make his choice and he created  something called the Honey Ranch and this was easily the best drink out of all 4. Highly recommend Brach Madrid Bar","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Doron Privé","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKkdtQAXsQ4Kx4kWjv6_tOt_smbLwFWiIFkEVxSgS1lbwIt1iE=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The atmosphère is so nice and good looking. Waiters talk English, French and many other languages. The desert is also really nice and the hot chocolate as well.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBGNDjRP7qu2ClEYtV4cn-o&fid=0x0:0x6fb77fa1ec2cddc7"],"When":"2025-12-4"}]
