[{"Name":"Julie","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXH7UdXF38H7tw2bKYGWUbsn1Cs7gUvRNDSveMuy1E2EBafPiY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Finally, some delicious paella!! We ordered the Jamon Croquetas 9.90€ for 4, Paella de Mariscos (seafood) 39€, and Paella de la Tierra (with chicken) 35€. The paella comes in a generous portion, meant for 2 people, but enough for 3-4 people if you order other dishes. The Croquetas were creamy and delicious, and you have the option of grated cheese on top. The Mousse de Maracuya (passionfruit mousse) 6.5€ was nice too! Waiter was friendly and it was a pleasant experience.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA9XmiUv-ASNiLZ4uLBOjrn&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2026-1-4"},{"Name":"Chris","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLykolCPtJYDXIpMyWtyS9rFCf8M6Mo_ZzAllh6GVaFyxcAtQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I’m afraid hidden gems don’t really exist anymore — especially in Madrid.
But we stumbled upon this place completely by chance, and it turned out to be the most delightful surprise of our trip.

The warmth of the girl who served us, the family-like atmosphere, the genuine joy that both the space and the staff radiate — it was the most pleasant experience I had in Madrid. They welcomed and treated us as if we were local friends they had known for years.

The food was outstanding. Truly the most delicious paella I’ve had — without question.
If I could give 6 stars, I absolutely would.

Everything — absolutely everything — was perfect.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCcwwcHZqWRaWd4k9Z8cnJK&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2025-12-1"},{"Name":"Columbus OH","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJFR1ew59Pu4fKMB1dKiDKS0efj50o09GiFKPDkzLE2BQaSHQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We stopped here for dinner after visiting Museo Reina Sofía.  It’s a cozy, intimate spot, and we were seated quickly.  The food was delicious, especially the citrus walnut salad, though the portion was on the small side.  Service was friendly and welcoming.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCZJNp_i3kPcsZTLP0LOa_t&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2026-1-25"},{"Name":"Joe Robinsmith","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXCt3OB8J6JL_p5z1RuFYneTN8umOPokuG7MHLjzHQ90PatElxm=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Lola Si Mola is a hidden gem. Seated immediately, food was ordered and at the table very quickly. The Cool Tequenos were delightful. The Patacon Molon 2.0 was delicious. The Bao Molon Pink and Green an incredible twist on fusion food at its best. Sangria was not overly sweet. The Zinio Rioja Seco, rare white Rioja, crisp and bright, reminded me of pinot gris from BC. Passion fruit mousse was light and fluffy. Decor was sassy, music made me want to rumba. Service was superb.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAr1BY-96wuOjrQ6W9lMcBe&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2025-10-9"},{"Name":"Metin Esgin","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU2c8IqL2bwNHcBS64W0F2MKcSmyZ6DQ4hkknKWmcW71yX1t5Il=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"2-3 years ago i was here for lunch, and i was served with a guy with lotsa character and the food was amazing. I not only put this restaurant in my Madrid list but also favorited it; a rating only 3 restaurants have in Madrid. Since then I could never make it back.. it was closedZz it was full.. i didn’t have an opportunity etc. Today i was determined to do it, and by God I did when all roads were blocked in Madrid. And i wish i didn’t.. that i lived with the memory. Unhappy and uninterested service personnel to the point of being rude and most importantly totally average or below average food that you can find any roadside average restaurant. I feel there has been an ownership change and they are living off their laurels but won’t last long. What a pity!

Note: as i am still in the restaurant, i adled to one of the nicer ladis and she confirmed about ownership change","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDLViJmB1eOwzE_q1HBsKfK&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2025-10-10"},{"Name":"Hela Tih","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWNhSdWT03serDQn4m4eVqNfqCmPZs7Ht2FLHwQMHecmVnsKycX=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"A Hidden Gem Worth Reserving!
This tiny restaurant is an absolute treasure. The cozy space fills up quickly, so it’s definitely best to reserve ahead of time — and once you taste the food, you’ll understand why. Every plate is wonderfully prepared, bursting with fresh flavors and incredible attention to detail. Despite its small size, the atmosphere feels warm and inviting, and the quality of the dishes easily rivals much larger, high-end places.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBjuxngL2zjis01FIME6cAK&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2025-11-14"},{"Name":"Shaista Patel","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLg7xi4OntbtCyHu-Q80_hfXomnxlJeMN75R5etQRJB3irDZw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We were hungry and looking for a road side cafe searched on Google and when we walked up , we saw a lot of cafes but we kept walking and when we got here , the warmth of the people and the environment that greeted us swept us off our feet and then came the food and we went to heaven . The tacos , the bao buns , the scallops in garlic and the highlight was the buttered octopus ♥️♥️♥️♥️
Thank you for an amazing meal","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCjwyIHlzauvkl9TYzQUanK&fid=0x0:0xc4af59b9521e42e7"],"When":"2025-11-14"},{"Name":"Ching-ching Caballero","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWoiZ_V5bnHxfgQ1zH3EKxPtDT69nLdAoGUsvTFkabyvacUlOc=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"It was okay. [{"Name":"Nicole Cunningham","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX9x3i6hs_OpoaEbv5FevvBdCk2ErTm9nzClEO16x0ZRSwsyqR30Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This place has a really nice vibe, overall it is a fantastic restaurant for dinner. We appreciated the cozy ambiance, the music is good (not too loud or distracting), and the service is great.

We put food 4/5 stars only because some of the more expensive dishes we ordered (salmon and filet mignon) had smaller portions than expected for the cost.

Besides this, we had such a great time; we even got a pitcher of sangria AND dessert! If you’re looking for a more elegant vibe but cozy with good food variety, I would recommend this restaurant.

Also a shout out to our server Caroline who was accommodating and spoke English.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAcFaONeLn34ECGDs_TzLai&fid=0x0:0x377dd10b2206ed1c"],"When":"2026-1-8"},{"Name":"James","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocILumSZmCo9kHiTaEjd4HuzRvkD4IbDcapiehdg1RcQ9jD96w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"A group of us tried out this place for dinner. Reservation process (online) was easy. We got a spacious table. The waiter was a bit dry and unsmiling though - said water was coming but then promptly forgot it until we reminded him. Worthwhile if you need a break from tapas and traditional Spanish food (and hey have salads!)","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhChL_8dwh49zUTWHDxuoM64&fid=0x0:0x377dd10b2206ed1c"],"When":"2025-10-7"},{"Name":"Raul Antonio Rodriguez","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVcT9X26fpUVBDOcNBXOGhcCHUKLS84nSy_jlrl6TO625EApwq-4w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our “Social Club” every night while in Madrid. Gracias 🫶","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBux5xAGgrN5rg162ZnyfP1&fid=0x0:0x377dd10b2206ed1c"],"When":"2026-1-21"},{"Name":"Newsham","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUDJHivjRbWs3Xegl5eGdps9FG-8fSZ7S2oX1TTawIYJcdg-g9S7g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The restaurant was definitely busy, but Alexis made our whole evening wonderful. It's very comfortable and offers excellent value for money.
I highly recommend trying the solomillo montadito (sirloin steak sandwich) and the codfish with alioli and honey. The torrijas quemadas de Santa Teresa (Santa Teresa burnt French toast) are, without a doubt, the best dessert. While we did have to wait, the service was very fast 🩵","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCD_km8Ny2OyV8sh7WYoV5X&fid=0x0:0xfd95dfdda11c0775"],"When":"2025-12-2"},{"Name":"Bella Hou","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXifA_glc-NlijYlKuyZjIJLXzhVf90HFZ1snwZEGbEK-klGvIO=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant today. The food was delicious and the prices were very reasonable for the quality.

I wanted to leave a special thank-you to the two reception girls who handled the waiting list today. There were three ladies didn’t understand the waiting list and they thought I cut in the line. I was single and I felt very confused. Both of the receptionists stayed calm and explained the waiting process clearly. They managed this stressful situation with patience, which made me feel safe.

Please pass on my thanks to both of the receptionists. Their work today truly made a difference, and I hope the tension didn’t affect their mood. I’ll definitely come back and recommend this restaurant to everyone!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBHUQBbq8NCGXatxncQfVHT&fid=0x0:0xfd95dfdda11c0775"],"When":"2025-11-16"},{"Name":"Zixi Peng","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLu4SQ7qtXOihy4TuUNWrD9sFEC7iy8_7VLm1Te1jOtVnkoOA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Exceptional Service by ECAI at Vinitus!

Dined at Vinitus in Spain today and had an absolutely wonderful experience, largely thanks to our server, ECAI. From the moment we were seated, her attention to detail and warm hospitality stood out.

She was attentive, patient, and genuinely thoughtful—making excellent recommendations from the menu and ensuring our drinks were always refreshed without being intrusive. What truly impressed us was how she noticed small things, like adjusting the pace of our dishes when she saw we were chatting, and even kindly explaining the ingredients and origins of some local specialties we were curious about.

ECAI’s service was professional, friendly, and added so much to our meal. The food at Vinitus was delicious, but it’s staff like her that make a restaurant memorable. Thank you, ECAI, for making our dining experience so special!

Highly recommend Vinitus, and if you visit, hope you’re lucky enough to be served by ECAI.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBAx_kzs_LNUJvsq8XJ1M_s&fid=0x0:0xfd95dfdda11c0775"],"When":"2026-1-25"},{"Name":"Chao Wu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXqiZkKGaaizYgyJveFsBC5IqC6vZH7Ozx9eBkQxkt6V1GBmpc=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"One of the best restaurants that I ever eat. Especially during my holidays, I don’t eat in the same restaurant twice coz I would love to try different things. [{"Name":"Victoria Shkirenko","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK5Q808yim_dl_ZRhRGTOSNlEJhjkb42MZAUdwRXHMcVahbzg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The staff was exceptionally friendly and accommodating, with some members speaking fluent English. The presence of an English menu made the ordering process smooth.

The menu itself was outstanding, catering to various dietary preferences. I personally loved the crab croquettes, prawn paella, and sea bass. I can't wait to return to Madrid and explore their meat dishes.

However, the true star of the meal was the cheesecake. It was unlike any I've ever tasted - incredibly creamy, not overly sweet, and remarkably light. Resisting a second portion was a challenge in itself!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDFkIOEtAE&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2023-11-3"},{"Name":"Aaron Chang","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV9KqYMvqxodidZovOay99-SLJEsW8ugiDNw2AmJv1m5QdQuXCm=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"One of the best experiences I had so far.
Staff members are attentive, especially Adrian. He explained most of the dishes and his suggestions are amazing.
All the foods are layered with umami, I can almost feel how focused the chefs are when making these amazing dishes.

Super delicious that I visited them again the next day, a perfect ending for my trip in Madrid.
A place you must not miss if you are a foodie like me.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDu34-wZA&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2022-9-2"},{"Name":"Deming","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWnU8uPPlK03WRRn2bib-ZJj1A3SmJdjaw7tLYHboA8_cLEf1Xq=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"4 stars for the food and additional star for the excellent service.

The torreznos was crispy but we find the pork gamey taste too strong especially at the fats portion. The dumplings skin was too thick for me, perhaps it's my Asian palate. Balacao was good and the pumpkin flan was a enjoyable.

On the pricey side but still acceptable considering the good ambiance, pleasant food and excellent service.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICOk9eOLQ&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2022-6-18"},{"Name":"Luca D'Amico","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjViLrYKg9kGLxcsyKd3krOORQDYc2DRJVKRPn4WcPIBIBUBKuKJ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"We arrived at 1 PM. The waiters were still setting up the tables and food deliveries were coming in. They took our order right away but then disappeared for a long time. No one came to check on us or even bring water. The food was average — the paella was very salty, and the beef tartare was made with cuts that definitely weren’t fillet. Overall, a disappointing experience. Perhaps they should consider opening a bit later if they’re not ready to serve customers at 1 PM.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sie-Hang Cheung","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUsoYtdX12BukZS1h8QELThphXri3NN8lpVXJmQPUtLXqua1GrGLg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Very good quality good for the price you pay. The staff is friendly, also very helpful as the terrace was fully reserved and we had indoor seats, but they let us have a drink outside and before dinner indoors. I recommend the torreznos which tastes amazing! It doesn't have the pork smell that people dislike. The Colombia dessert is also very unique and tasty. Definitely give this place a go. One last tip, ask for what they have outside the regular menu, seems like they usually have quite a bit","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDK_5Sa2QE&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2021-5-22"},{"Name":"Fiona Garvey","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUbyE9PY3Y5jofrSMX3LFqLowjhy7RAvZ_Cnjl7r6MByw8FxtH5hw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"For price:versus food quality, Salino was thoroughly enjoyable.  Highly recommend the tuna tartar and the mushrooms for starters. My fellow diners also loved the pork belly (can’t say it’s my thing). For main we had fish a sea bass and monkfish, both which were very good.

Dessert of coconut & passion fruit, the cheesecake and coulant were all so good! The photo of the empty plates says it all :)

Dani and his team did a great job, service was friendly and efficient.

Definitely recommend","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICrgbrsuwE&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2024-7-7"},{"Name":"Katie","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWYlSx_VNVDDP3jdTZVeylms0Lc7BuIf2W-tE0hLowR2TlA8BTA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Great restaurant, attentive friendly staff and delicious meals.
First visit here: I forgot to take photos of all the main meals, but here is some of the desserts. Everything was beautifully presented. We will be back!

Update:
Second time here, we had the following…
- Torreznos 5/5 ⭐️
- The oxtail massaman curry 5/5
- The duck paella (a bit heavy on the salt) 3.5/5
- Cheese cake 5/5

Another Update!
We love this restaurant ❤️
- Croquetas de centolla 4.5/5
- Parpatana de atún guisada al vino tinto 5/5 👌
-  Corvina asada con caponata siciliana y mojo rojo  5/5
- tarta de limón 5/5
- Coulant de calabaza, chocolate blanco y helado de tomillo 4/5

Staff are excellent as usual, and the interior is beautiful too ☺️","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgID2u7PwuAE&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2022-5-26"},{"Name":"Lily","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJYdFDxnk1OwzrRXSZK00rOydV9_lBEvbSsF_JhGfSp_ntz0Tfw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This restaurant opens at 1pm (which is later than what is on Google). The inside of this restaurant is nice and it does seem to be an upscaled restaurant. They typically serve larger plates rather than the smaller tapas you'll find in other restaurants.

They provide bread with gazpacho before you get your orders, so I'd definitely recommend trying the gazpacho on bread since that's the standard Spanish cold soup. The main courses were good as well. I got the Duck Paella and enjoyed it a lot. The plating was very nice and the flavors were good as well. Would recommend checking out this restaurant if you happen to be nearby!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICOsdmkXQ&fid=0x0:0xdb2d176896b2a52b"],"When":"2022-6-12"}]

We will definitely come back next time we are in Madrid.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCG_7lRFKU7lc_3_yK9Uncd&fid=0x0:0xf24b7c0c949c37da"],"When":"2025-10-3"},{"Name":"Barry Zoller","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIvZ0q8gTNXAowRK2fd642k94e9hU_jdidRa8psM5lDRDMmnw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The food here is delicious.  We shared the salad with goat cheese, sliced entrecôte steak with fries, and the pistachio cheesecake.  A perfect lunch after a visit to the Prado a few blocks away.  The salad, steak and cheesecake were all the best that I’ve had during my one month visit to Madrid.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAFhB75KHN8-sU8o1jBOAm1&fid=0x0:0xf24b7c0c949c37da"],"When":"2025-10-18"},{"Name":"Dory Benami","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVMA9O_nlK2NgT3LGeWpGaGecR_4tCsk28BT-Izx-je_mOyN4bb=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"The brisket here is fine, but nowhere near Texas standards — or what my Jewish wife makes on Friday nights. Prices are on the high side. The burrata was delicious, the chicken strips and chili sauce were also solid. Patricia, our Venezuelan waitress, was kind but only brought us the WiFi password at the end, which was frustrating.

Family-wise, they had a high chair but no baby changing table. The 10% surcharge for outdoor seating felt ridiculous. Toward the end, several Chinese tourists appeared and were turned away with talk of “phantom reservations,” which was odd.

Not sure I’d ever come back deliberately, but it was an interesting stop.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCYySX9G0WmmlZfs34u7bwF&fid=0x0:0xf24b7c0c949c37da"],"When":"2025-10-5"},{"Name":"Selwyn Hunt","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXT8rE_eThKeYSb77TyDoRjj1jdjsGBUIgf_WIH1FuJrvf5M3KcIw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We wandered the Prado Museum neighborhood after a morning there looking for lunch and all roads led to Gustavo’s special little restaurant, Brisket. [{"Name":"R J","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKUdkZ5dndaVnmcLHjK8DT7L2ovslP_uEh9-FIHghQMt2uUeg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Located near Puerta del Sol, Inclán Brutal Bar is a masterclass in culinary theater, blending psychedelic decor with avant-garde Spanish fusion. The "brutal" experience lives up to its name, offering a high-energy atmosphere complete with neon lights and eclectic art that makes every corner Instagram-worthy.
Drinks are served in whimsical vessels like kraken, dragon eggs or ceramic character heads and are a crowd pleaser.

Each dish was delicious and a perfect fusion of Asian & Spanish cuisine- flavor bombs!  All served with the restaurant's signature creative and theatrical flair.

Despite the upscale plating and central location, the overall bill was surprisingly reasonable. Servers were attentive and friendly. Because of its popularity, suggest to make reservations in advance.

We walked in, drawn by the eclectic ambience and luckily found the last spot at the bar as all tables were full. We had a great experience so went back again, but this time with a reservation to enjoy the full dine in experience on New Year's Eve with lively atmosphere all around!

Highly recommended and we will definitely go back when we visit Madrid next time!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDrzTbGXQakc_nwHVg6re-A&fid=0x0:0x4c115f1b554bf55a"],"When":"2026-2-1"},{"Name":"Gabriel Radford","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVwcyb-dRAmO-1NM9nQfZHDz6GtwhkUAPGwtqhfxlDBGuIhY8AwKg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Lots going on here but the essential point is that the food is excellent. So disappointed
The monk fish was mediocre for this type of restaurant. The ray was better.
The service was excellent attentive and professional at all times.
The food could be better and not worth the price tag unfortunately","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDEvOzNa9pAyBM_f9CtFbHb&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2025-9-29"},{"Name":"Cristobal Daly","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVzHqHbhYV7OZ3qw0A3umYZMxxGjaFKM2jfVvp-yA-2MBGlwbPx9w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"I’ve always avoided restaurants that focus more on technique than on the product itself, and Alabaster is one of them.

Elegant place with good service, but the food feels flat. Neither the tomato, the “berberechos”, nor the meat stood out. Well executed, sure, but far from exciting.

The wine list is classic and rather dull, with only a couple of Champagnes worth noting.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAaVhrO6fwSJsPZxBuBbWwM&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2025-10-6"},{"Name":"Oscar J","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXGWvO5SunNzRLWncLMkcq3noTLNMKczB3Jy-h-TtjQmanKF6pf=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Ordered the tasting menu and had pleasant and knowledgable servers (they can speak English). It is truly an excellent meal when dessert is my least favorite course (even with cold broccoli served with the beef). Each course was different from the last and was just the right amount of food to leave not hungry and feeling fine. Would definitely return.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDz1PzMRw&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2024-6-7"},{"Name":"Christian Weiß","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUDBcy92ijpgR_vNdQME5trpPojbsgBnYRhHtLJkKp0mprvjZDa=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Great restaurant in private atmosphere!
Service, food and drinks are outstanding.
We had wonderful time with our partners.
Please come here for stylish food accompanied with outstanding wine selection.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC1jqvOfA&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2023-12-29"},{"Name":"p k","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIklDZByFjXehCQ19TXT7uuhTez2aIV8M2nq2zkyRRxyoa02Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"What an extraordinarily sophisticated and posh dining experience! I arrived there (solo) out of curiosity after searching for nearby Gourmet restaurants on Google Maps. It was a rainy day, and I had been out walking....  I wasn't expecting availability w/o having reservations, but they happily accommodated me. Admittedly, I wish I had arrived better dressed; I felt a little too casual, but I was not made to feel uncomfortable by any means. Being solo... Graciously, the maitre d even went to the extent of asking if I was comfortable at the table I had been sat at: (around small, quiet, intimate family diners).

Starting off, I had an excellent, perfectly balanced Manhattan.

Next came an amuse bouche  & complementary marinated green olives and a nice rustic house bread.
Having seen other positive reviews & wanting to try as many tastes as possible, I chose the tasting menu.

It turned out to be definitely well-defined perfection. Every course was executed with character and subtleness matching the ingredients and choice of assembly. Each course was satisfyingly built upon the next with no serving  being so rich or powerful that it left me feeling overwhelmed or unprepared for the following dish.

I didn't choose the wine pairing, but I asked the sommelier instead to choose a nice dry white wine that would compliment the complete tasting menu. Excellent job!!!

I felt happy and indulged at the end.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDxoeOFoQE&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2023-6-9"},{"Name":"Sophia","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI6NsEoN94oT3XLwASGnqxvVCJpkKO3HLhIaeBXixpmwf0pN-O9=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We got the tasting menu, and it was delicious! They made sure everything we got was dairy free, and the dessert was phenomenal. The staff were all very friendly and happy to explain each course. We couldn’t finish the wine pairings because the pours were so generous 😅","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgID6tKf9jgE&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2021-9-21"},{"Name":"brian watkins","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI2D36MBg16b-vpJpSpNk9ExJzk9oBEQI2DTSzfKOVM5GiErA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"From beginning to end Alabaster demonstrated a phenomenal dining experience.
The space is elegant and comfortable. Our table of four did the chef's tasting menu with wine pairings. The front of house staff were all kind, attentive, and informative. Special kudos to the sommelier who's pairings were exceptional and who took the time to educate us about uncommon grape varietals around the country. She was a delight.
The chef's offering that evening made for a fantastic tour of the seafood and other flavors of Galacia. Through the balances of flavors in each dish it was evident much thought and care went into them.
This is a restaurant staffed by consummate professionals at the top of their game. It was a pleasure to dine here.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICe6cTPKQ&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2022-9-17"},{"Name":"MenuPassport","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXe-vUFvX1KfuTbUsbQxCMrY7JWMnxMU3GT6sp6Yl-0QQlUOdGu=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our evening at Alabaster in Madrid, spurred by a friend's glowing recommendation, turned into a delightful culinary adventure. We opted for the tasting menu, where each dish came with its own story—some told beautifully through artful plating, while others left a bit to the imagination. But here’s the twist: what some dishes lacked in presentation, they more than made up for in flavor. Each bite was a revelation, with rich, layered tastes that danced on the palate. The unexpected contrast between the visual and the taste made the experience all the more intriguing. Alabaster is the kind of place that reminds you—sometimes it’s what’s inside that truly counts. I’m glad we took the leap and explored this hidden gem, where flavor reigns supreme. Definitely worth a visit for those who appreciate substance over style!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDntIqHFg&fid=0x0:0x60c7f313d54bea3f"],"When":"2024-10-3"}]

[{"Name":"Nisha Gohil","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIzz3nHvOZmLsTxk1A96cuc3UAfOzqiF1mX-67tuHaops9vyYw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Right.. this pops up as one of the best restaurants in Madrid. It’s great for aesthetic photos and presentation - the food is good but not wow.

Food - for starters we had the burrata and the tacos. Both were really good and for mains we had the wagyu burger and potatoes.

Service - our server was really good but he was alone downstairs. They def could do with more staff in the bottom floor hence the lower rating.

Atmosphere - great ambience and aesthetic. Love their presentations","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCEN3j6SIOmGBG8dzxkjkaJ&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2026-1-16"},{"Name":"Huss Suli","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWPDXzDXt2G3a0GDHH2-PobLlTKHmPRIDr7yUWEyhc0hiRYEly4=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Such a dreamy spot in Madrid! The vibes make you feel like you stepped into a colorful little escape — almost like taking a break from the city rain and worries.

We tried their seafood paella and it was full of flavor — rich, perfectly cooked, and packed with shrimp and shellfish that tasted fresh and juicy. Every bite was comforting and satisfying.

The crispy sandwich was golden and crunchy on the outside, soft and flavorful inside, and served in the cutest way.

Special thanks to Ismael for the warm service — he made the experience even better.

Great food, fun atmosphere, and the perfect place to relax and enjoy the moment.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA97qVt-VgKo9qSOg3zjxUE&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2026-1-28"},{"Name":"Alexis S","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVp8e3BCs6uQ5Fr_Fwq5oJ-d4Pl1n9MUb3cGearU-OqIOMmnXFl=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"I hated this place. The service was alright and the garish decor was almost entertaining but the food was simply terrible. The vegetarian options were limited so I went with the pasta parcels. This was a mistake. The pasta was cooked alright but they were very sweet. The sweetness mixed with the cheese, pepper, and creamy sauce was not a good combination. Luckily, it somehow also managed to be lacking in flavour. I would avoid going here.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBqseaC1d-XEAN3BKkDL08k&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2026-2-18"},{"Name":"Kreesa Mhz","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW1jc4ufTXTFz3iley8u27d7T3Hd_lUhf8YN51eg_gpTqCwMoqj=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Rosi La Loca is such a fun and unforgettable dining experience. The atmosphere is vibrant and quirky, with colorful décor that instantly puts you in a good mood. The food was just as impressive—fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and beautifully presented dishes.

We tried the veal cheek cannelloni, and chicken croquettes, and everything was perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The cannelloni was rich, tender, and incredibly comforting, while the croquettes were crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside—definitely a highlight of the meal. The cocktails were creative and delicious, making the experience even better.

It is a little bit pricey, but the quality of the food, the unique atmosphere, and the overall experience make it worth it. Service was friendly and attentive, adding to the lively vibe of the place. If you’re looking for great food and a restaurant full of personality, Rosi La Loca is absolutely worth a visit.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDZwXmTeYnbcD1padD9URFQ&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2026-1-2"},{"Name":"Winston","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXd0DXjOEGEEX3aKy67BsXrBGI17_8SKqCyv_TSek-cBbvxSA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We stumbled upon Rosi La Loca on a rainy afternoon wandering the barrios of Madrid. I was hesitant to try it because it had so many reviews and I was afraid Rosi La Loca would have no substance, I was wrong.
Atmosphere : 5 off the hook, this place is like being in a fairy tale or Alice in wonderland.
Service:5 great service. They don’t allow dogs but still went out of their way to let us sit on the outside seating area without a reservation on a busy afternoon.
Food: 5 the biggest surprise of all. To drink I had the Rosi in Hawaii. Great depth in flavor with the smokey Mezcal balancing the drink.We had the bravas locas to start. The potatoes were crispy and had great flavor. The salsa had just the right amount of spice. Next we tried the croquettes de Rossi. The Iberico Jamon fillings texture and flavor was spot on. The Boa de costillade terna was really amazing. The fluffy Chinese buns were a pillowy rapper for the sweet and juicy filling. Last we had the tacos no mames wey. The corn tortillas filled with pork shoulder were juicy and tender, perfect.
Rosi La Loca is a ride you want to get on, just make sure you make reservations.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAKGWRc52ZxVS0-ZY3SUk3r&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2026-1-31"},{"Name":"M D","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUh0_tRMz6bQWy67g0b8fm5YcF_0WAEuzcZCsI9agkY4RGRNzaY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"One of the best experiences in dinning I have had.  The service was superb. The atmosphere and decor is fun and lively.  The taco no mane’s dude were delightful, light and full of flavor. The Udon noodles with tuna tartar was seasoned to perfections. The Boletus Rice exceeded my expectations, creamy, tender rice with a mushroom/truffle flavor.  We also got to meet the infamous Edwin, La Reina. He great possible energy and the friendliest smile.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCG00eP8jyXJjei-_BEy-kh&fid=0x0:0x62b53647e666590f"],"When":"2025-9-13"},{"Name":"Jordan Lazaro","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI1qMVO_MeP7avxyB916ZPXUPDwqkwHhYl3RIO0DXzaZcfW3g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Had the best meal and food experience by far! [{"Name":"Zsolt Szemerszky","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXnfpy0tu8xqJ1Mm56Nx5UoXLm8kN4LkUp9n2AYBjtPeBWfcg80ow=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Overall, Los 33 offers a fantastic culinary experience, provided you are willing to wait between 30 and 60 minutes for a table.

Our experience started with an unsuccessful attempt to book a table in advance. Upon arrival, we quickly realised that reservations are possible for "some guests", but only by calling or asking in person. Lesson learned. Although the waiting time created a slightly negative first impression, we were far from the only ones waiting, which already hinted at the restaurant’s popularity.

A positive note from the start: the doorman speaks excellent English, as do several members of the staff, which makes the experience smoother for international guests.

Once inside, Los 33 immediately impresses with its striking atmosphere and open-fire cooking concept. We were lucky enough to be seated close to the grill, allowing us to witness the culinary craftsmanship that defines the restaurant.

Our waitress was outstanding; attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. She guided us toward the right choices and suggested several off-menu specials, which turned out to be excellent. A big thank-you to her for elevating the entire experience.

For starters, we ordered the Ibérico ham croquettes, which were very good, as well as the Los 33 egg. The capers served at the table were a nice and unexpected alternative to the usual olives. We also tried their signature Bikini sandwich, a rich and flavourful ham toast.

However, my absolute favourite starter was the burrata dish served with homemade bread. The combination of burrata with grapes and basil created a beautifully balanced and unexpected flavour profile, instantly making me a fan of Los 33.

For the main course, I initially opted for the Angus steak with green peppers. While the peppers were excellent -enhanced by a pleasant charcoal smokiness- I found the steak itself too chewy and below my personal standards. The green peppers could also have benefited from slightly less salt too.

We ended on a high note by following our waitress’s recommendation for the peppered bone-in sirloin steak. Wow. Perfectly cooked, incredibly flavourful, and absolutely memorable.

The cocktails were decent but not particularly remarkable. That said, Los 33 clearly shines when it comes to meat and fire-driven flavours, and that’s where the restaurant truly wins you over.

All in all, Los 33 is among the best choices in Madrid for a bold, flavour-forward dinner experience. Well done. Definitely a place to come back.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAeoPgJT3mIxgBX36ivyHIr&fid=0x0:0x3d2bc0263b5cb0d3"],"When":"2026-1-6"},{"Name":"Sebastian Delgado","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW-DDtJ-j3WSeN5JKjoP82WJ9ecYI-02bLSGwlCwwI9RTsNawdxjg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Amazing food. All the dishes we had were delicious. They upscaled the choripan in a great way. All the meats great. And the deserts were phenomenal. You def need a reservation.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBVpzNettOmFDiSyPl4FA83&fid=0x0:0x3d2bc0263b5cb0d3"],"When":"2025-11-9"},{"Name":"Ella Roberts","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK3EeJJZOL8Yl7aC8p4we077TXxof6bu0If0ukMlrR2PuT54A=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I loved this place. It had such a buzzy atmosphere, such a fun place to go for dinner on a Friday or Saturday with friends. For starters we got the chorizo style sausage (I forget the name exactly) which were delicious. The steak was sensational - as were the sides such as the salads and fries. The carrots were also delicious, the flavours were really interesting but I think they could’ve done with cooking a little longer. The desserts are all worth getting too - especially the creme caramel. We were lucky to get a table in the dining area, as the bar was completely full. To be honest, I never expected a bikini sandwich to be so delicious — definitely a must-try! I also go around the city searching for the best tortilla, and so far the one at Los 33 is my favorite. We also tried the meat, and although I only have a poor-quality photo, it was fantastic as well.
I loved this place. There was a line of about 10–12 people ahead of us, most of whom had joined the waiting list weeks in advance. We decided to take a chance and waited about an hour, eventually getting lucky with two seats at the bar.
The ambiance inside absolutely lives up to the hype. Warm lighting, great music, and a lively yet intimate vibe. The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, especially as we don’t speak Spanish—they took the time to walk us through the menu and offer recommendations.
We started with the grilled bikini sandwich, a must-try. It’s a simple dish, but executed to perfection. We also tried the Chamizo fried pastry—nicely done, but didn’t quite stand out the way the other dishes did.
For mains, we ordered the entraña wagyu steak, which was cooked flawlessly. It was paired beautifully with grilled cauliflower served over a surprisingly delicious purée—an unexpected highlight of the meal.
Drinks were spot-on too. My wife enjoyed her Tiki Taka, while I had two vermouths that complemented the meal perfectly.

They have a wood fired grill in the back that adds to the ambiance. The hostess in the entrance could be more welcoming and kind, the service could also be better. We will definitely be back to try other things in the menu.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKENmsirbD-PiaXQ&fid=0x0:0x3d2bc0263b5cb0d3"],"When":"2025-6-7"}]

[{"Name":"Kevin William Charles Hunter","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWnHtjcGgANu_PfgGzRLHFPcE3SfvkewgCyinAXqREeFseuW5U=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This is the second time I have been to this Indian restaurant.  It's walking distance from the metro Ibiza or the Gregorio Marañón General University Hospital.

As can be seen from the photos the decoration is colourful yet tasteful - I have never been to India so I am not sure if their decoration is authentic but it definitely feels like it takes you there. The food was nicely presented with various sauces and/or vegetables on top.

The service was fantastic both times that I have been here. This time I was by myself near the door and every time someone came in or out, the door was left ajar. I got up to close it once or twice, then the waiters there made sure I didn't get up again and were on the case.  The food was served quickly and piping hot.

Now for the food, I have been here twice now and this time I had the menu of the day. With this, you get a starter (two Chicken Samosas) which were lovely, a main (Chicken Vindaloo), a side dish: rice or a Naan bread, dessert and a drink. I love spicy food  (although there was a time when I couldn't stand it), the hotter the better!  The taste of the Vindaloo is lovely, although both times I haven't found it that spicy - to a lot of people it is / will be spicy. The first time I made the mistake of thinking that the Phal could be ordered with lamb but here it can't and this time, as it was the menu, I knew what I was getting but still content with the taste.  I ordered the rice and, a beer and a Mango Lassi for dessert - I was a little greedy and ordered a Pashwani Naan, also. As it was the menu it was priced reasonable at around 11,50 € plus extra for the Nann bread .

I would definitely recommend this place as it is not overpriced and you get your money's worth. The next time I go, I will be trying the Phal to see if it will blow my mind, as well as, my taste buds!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICGlZDzjwE&fid=0x0:0xc5ad823cd7358720"],"When":"2021-11-6"},{"Name":"Thabo Sivagurunathan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW1xPuOV7ISsT6ODMFOU4AgCB0-WoNhmY9F8ZPgjxsJq4kZWx3E=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"We had a great experience at this restaurant! [{"Name":"Mitch Davis","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWgyVjGTHp0FhywZV6WUfN-6XUTl-X3UYXMtuPRWwmSIMt5hBM6=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We’ve been traveling through Paris and Madrid, eating at multiple Michelin-starred restaurants, and this was easily our favorite meal of the trip. We had meatballs, risotto, and tagliatelle, along with two picantes to drink.

The meatballs were incredibly tender with an extraordinary savory depth. The lemon and capers pasta felt almost magically composed, the citrus bold but never sour, the capers adding the perfect touch of salt, and the pasta so fresh it seemed like it was handmade moments before serving. It was a serious contender for one of my top five meals of all time.

Service was warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was simple, elegant, and inviting. I absolutely loved this restaurant, and will be back anytime I’m in Madrid again.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD7fLNxBZqS6slJD4oG26Dr&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2026-2-16"},{"Name":"Mat Ulrich","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWM0LkkrV-SllX5Lzqje0Z8S1LLhCoGwsfs2zurbvZJFPTd2Mk=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Update: We had to go back for our last meal in Madrid because the first one was so good and our favorite after 6 days in the city. Read below:

My wife and I noticed this place on google maps and decided to try and see if they had availability….on a Sunday night, just after 9:30pm. Not only were they accommodating, they were so warm and welcoming! Immediately the Barman was helpful with a wine selection based upon a few questions he asked us and what we liked. Our server was Lidia and was so helpful and kind. We ordered two meat appetizers, then a mushroom risotto as the main to share. She suggested we go in reverse order from light to heavy, and she was right. Such a charming and delightful dining experience. Casual dress with the best of food. From the looks of it, I’d suggest reservations ahead of time as I think we got lucky on getting in as a walk up, and this is not a large restaurant trying to pump out dishes for the masses. This is for people who love food and the company that they keep. Trust the staff as you will have the best experience! DO NOT MISS!!!

We went back on Friday and got lucky as someone may have cancelled last minute. Raquel (I may be spelling her name wrong) was very helpful over the phone, and in-person as we were making a wine selection. She made a stellar recommendation that complimented everything we had. We tried different things from the menu this time and it was just as good as the first time. The entire staff helped us this time, including Lidia. When we come back to Madrid again we will make this place a priority. Well done, Ástor Gastro-Place.

It should be noted that this place never asked us for a review, which is quite uncommon with restaurants in the area. Don’t get me wrong, always happy to write a review if asked and the service/food are good. But this place has earned their great reputation!!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDGc2agVTZSMM3jLbvPgWBB&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2025-9-28"},{"Name":"JP Chetcuti","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVaOBHpOnsBvGktgBUgQp-yAvWhzsl8H5gXXK9bQBXiY4XX6PsqZw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Friendly, family run place having. Only 8 tables ensures diners experience personalised attentiveness. The food is exceptional and of exceptional standard. A very intimate, modern environment off the beaten track. Highly recommended unlike many touristy establishments.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAF15m0qpTfTLfyTAzCy5vP&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2026-1-4"},{"Name":"Evie Bustamante","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIt12RWp0NgsfYN6ggmIUdBn-elXe1rhegYIYz57X3WGUUr7Q=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Marvelous meal! The service is great, everyone is friendly and welcoming. Raquel is wonderful! The atmosphere is cozy and they have an open kitchen design. The food was outstanding, the Char Siu flavorful and very tender. The Risotto a perfect balance of creamy, savory, sweet, and bright. The lomo bajo was cooked perfectly, something I have found very hard to find in Madrid. Ástor is one of my favorite places in Madrid hands down.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhB0Xs37xChVJvSvNMnwHKjy&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2025-11-11"},{"Name":"Paulina J","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLTULqYFAhgdSduqA4Dhv0hCoh8xf_ogybgiYMlswY2VmGofaKe=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Every single dish we tried was delicious, fresh and beautifully presented. You can truly taste the quality and care that goes into food. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCe6cxxWzua2jAdIJfn0-8i&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2026-2-17"},{"Name":"Grace S","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLS5UlNG8pj9oVwlSLTf37LDhm_MhB-ow2ADs_rkzEdotRsymJC=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Best little gem we found on a small side street of Plaza Mayor. Best meal and service we had in Madrid. We will come back again when next in Madrid!

Started with complimentary croquettes followed by the Proveleta Astor, Marinated Fried Dogfish ceviche, tagliatelle with monkfish & prawn with wine by the glass of rjoja. Just perfect for two of us. Ended  with a half portion of Spanish cheesecake - divine! Plus a lovely complimentary digestive.

Highly recommend! Place was packed even as we left at 10pm. Wonderful wine as well...","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCocBYD3Wx01JF4OS54Vb-l&fid=0x0:0x80a15bc585f4b264"],"When":"2025-10-26"},{"Name":"Vishal Mishra","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIuD_eB5zBockIuTZ23CCgJlEYvDDrR5X6KC3qoibmo0um11Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Awesome eclectic interesting delicious fusion cuisine.
